keyPoints.en: Short message (about 80 words): answer all prompts in a friendly tone.
keyPoints.bm: Mesej pendek (kira-kira 80 patah perkataan): jawab semua gesaan dengan nada mesra.

keyPoints.en: Email/letter (about 125–150 words): greeting, purpose, all notes expanded, closing.
keyPoints.bm: E-mel/surat (kira-kira 125–150 patah perkataan): salam, tujuan, semua nota dikembangkan, penutup.

keyPoints.en: Match register: friends informal; principal/editor formal.
keyPoints.bm: Padankan laras: rakan tidak formal; pengetua/editor formal.

tip.en: Tick each note in the question as you cover it.
tip.bm: Tandakan setiap nota dalam soalan apabila telah dijawab.

keyPoints.en: Article: catchy title, hook, clear points, strong ending.
keyPoints.bm: Artikel: tajuk menarik, pembuka, isi yang jelas, penutup yang berkesan.

keyPoints.en: Review: what it is, description, strengths and weaknesses, recommendation.
keyPoints.bm: Ulasan: apa yang diulas, penerangan, kekuatan dan kelemahan, cadangan.

keyPoints.en: Report: formal, headings, findings and recommendations. Story: setting, conflict, climax, resolution.
keyPoints.bm: Laporan: formal, subtajuk, dapatan dan cadangan. Cerita: latar, konflik, klimaks, peleraian.

keyPoints.en: Part 3 is about 200–250 words — check your current exam guidelines.
keyPoints.bm: Bahagian 3 kira-kira 200–250 patah perkataan — semak garis panduan peperiksaan terkini.

keyPoints.en: One main idea per paragraph, starting with a topic sentence.
keyPoints.bm: Satu idea utama setiap perenggan, dimulakan dengan ayat topik.

keyPoints.en: Use varied connectors: adding, contrasting, result, sequencing.
keyPoints.bm: Gunakan penanda wacana yang pelbagai: menambah, pertentangan, akibat, urutan.

keyPoints.en: Vary sentence length and structure; proofread at the end.
keyPoints.bm: Pelbagaikan panjang dan struktur ayat; semak pada akhir.
